evidence: A calculation on committed products: the solved spherical sky (clear, ground albedo 0.1), the calendar's Earth spectrum, the surface-light product's ultraviolet, the biosphere's design guesses for the waters and this study's design guess for the crater lakes, through Earth's ocean optics with fresh water's scattering and ultraviolet absorption; geography's 16 px/deg depths. Earth's light requirements are reference points, and organisms are engineered. No organism, survival through the night, wave focusing, inelastic scattering or real reef shape is modelled.
reading_rule: Depths in metres below a flat surface; light just below the surface is depth 0. PAR is 400-700 nm photons in umol m-2 s-1; doses in mol m-2 per Earth day (umol m-2 s-1 x 0.0864). zones[world][water][latitude]: euphotic_noon_1pct_m (1% of the PAR just below the surface at local noon, mean chlorophyll; dawn and dusk beside it), euphotic_dose_m (lunar-day mean PAR falls to 0.4 mol m-2 d-1), twilight_feeding_end_m (noon illuminance falls to the fish feeding thresholds), disphotic_end_m (noon rod catch falls to the deep-sea limit; aphotic below), benthic_limit_m (lunar-day mean PAR at the floor falls to each threshold). floor[sea|lake][water][threshold][band] is km2 of floor lit above the threshold, bands of |latitude| in degrees, today's latitudes; for the turned Moon read each place at its new latitude. Declination 0 throughout except seasonal_75.

units.rod: umol m-2 s-1 weighted by an A1 template at 480 nm
units.dna: W m-2 weighted by the DNA-damage action spectrum, 1 at 300 nm

earth_terms_fixed.pure_water_absorption: IOCCG (2018) Table 1.1 composite below 420 nm in place of Smith and Baker (1981) below 380 nm and Pope and Fry 380-415 nm
earth_terms_fixed.dissolved_organic_uv: domain slope 0.0176 per nm carried into the ultraviolet; 0.025 below 350 nm as a sensitivity

crater_lake_record.basis: Design guess: a rain-fed crater lake on a small catchment, as poor in nutrients as the open sea with a little more plankton, and more dissolved organic matter and fines from its developed-soil shores. Between the open sea and the productive coast of waters.json.
